metadata.question: In 2004, using MODIS Land Surface Temperature (LST) data, did Death Valley, USA record the highest maximum daytime land surface temperature in the world?

data.raw_code: The question is: "In 2004, using MODIS Land Surface Temperature (LST) data, did Death Valley, USA record the highest maximum daytime land surface temperature in the world?" We need to: 1. Use MODIS LST data for 2004 (likely MOD11A1 or MOD11C3 products). 2. Find the maximum daytime LST in Death Valley for 2004. 3. Find the global maximum daytime LST for 2004. 4. Compare if Death Valley's maximum equals or exceeds the global maximum. Key considerations: - Data source: MODIS Land Surface Temperature Daily/8-Day/Monthly products. - Band: LST_Day_1km (for MOD11A1) or LST_Day (for MOD11C3). - Units: Kelvin * 0.02 (need to convert to Celsius for interpretation). - Location: Death Valley coordinates approx (36.5323°N, 116.9325°W). - Time: Year 2004. - Cloud/quality masking: Use QC band if available. - Global analysis: This is computationally heavy. We need a smart approach. Plan: 1. Use MOD11C3 monthly product (0.05° resolution) to reduce data volume. 2. For Death Valley: Get time series of monthly max LST, find annual max. 3. For Global: Get global monthly max composites, find annual max. 4. Compare values. Potential issues: - Empty collections for 2004? MODIS started in 2000, so data should exist. - No valid pixels after QC masking. - Calculation failures (invalid values). We'll structure: 1. Define Death Valley point and global geometry. 2. Get MOD11C3 collection for 2004. 3. Apply QC masking (if available in MOD11C3). 4. Convert LST values to Celsius. 5. Compute Death Valley max using reduceRegion. 6. Compute global max using reduceRegion with appropriate scale. 7. Validate results. 8. Compare and output answer. Fallback: If MOD11C3 has no data, try MOD11A1 (daily) but with aggregation. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry definitions const deathValley = ee.Geometry.Point(-116.9325, 36.5323).buffer(5000); // 5km buffer const world = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-180, -60, 180, 80]); // Exclude Antarctica // 2. Time range const startDate = '2004-01-01'; const endDate = '2004-12-31'; // 3. Data acquisition - MODIS Monthly LST (MOD11C3) let collection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11C3') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select(['LST_Day_CMG', 'QC_Day']); // Check if collection has data const collectionSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2004 MODIS Monthly Images: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("No monthly data found, trying daily product..."); // Fallback to MODIS Daily (MOD11A1) with monthly max composite collection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select(['LST_Day_1km', 'QC_Day']); const dailySize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2004 MODIS Daily Images: ${dailySize}`); if (dailySize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Create monthly max composites from daily data const months = ee.List.sequence(1, 12); collection = ee.ImageCollection.fromImages( months.map(function(m) { const start = ee.Date(startDate).advance(m.subtract(1), 'month'); const end = start.advance(1, 'month'); return collection .filterDate(start, end) .max() .set('system:time_start', start.millis()); }) ); } // 4. Processing function const processImage = function(image) { // Get LST band (scale 0.02 for Kelvin conversion) const lst = image.select(['LST_Day', 'LST_Day_1km', 'LST_Day_CMG']).reduce(ee.Reducer.firstNonNull()); // Convert to Celsius: (DN * 0.02) - 273.15 const lstCelsius = lst.multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15); // Create QC mask if QC band exists const qc = image.select(['QC_Day', 'QC']).reduce(ee.Reducer.firstNonNull()); let mask = ee.Image(1); // Simple QC check: bits 0-1 = 00 (LST produced, good quality) if (qc) { mask = qc.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0); } return lstCelsius.updateMask(mask).rename('LST_C'); }; const processedCol = collection.map(processImage); // 5. Get Death Valley maximum const dvMaxImage = processedCol.max(); const dvMax = dvMaxImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max(), geometry: deathValley, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_C'); // 6. Get global maximum (with coarser scale for performance) const globalMaxImage = processedCol.max(); const globalMax = globalMaxImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max(), geometry: world, scale: 50000, // 50km scale for global computation maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_C'); // 7. Get pixel counts for validation const dvCount = dvMaxImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: deathValley, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_C'); const globalCount = globalMaxImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: world, scale: 50000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_C'); // 8. Retrieve values const [dvMaxVal, globalMaxVal, dvCountVal, globalCountVal] = await Promise.all([ ee.Number(dvMax).getInfo(), ee.Number(globalMax).getInfo(), ee.Number(dvCount).getInfo(), ee.Number(globalCount).getInfo() ]); console.log(`Death Valley Max LST: ${dvMaxVal !== null ? dvMaxVal.toFixed(2) : 'null'}°C`); console.log(`Global Max LST: ${globalMaxVal !== null ? globalMaxVal.toFixed(2) : 'null'}°C`); console.log(`Death Valley Valid Pixels: ${dvCountVal}`); console.log(`Global Valid Pixels: ${globalCountVal}`); // 9. Validate results if (dvCountVal === 0 || globalCountVal === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } if (dvMaxVal === null || globalMaxVal === null || isNaN(dvMaxVal) || isNaN(globalMaxVal) || dvMaxVal > 100 || dvMaxVal < -100 || // Sanity check for LST globalMaxVal > 100 || globalMaxVal < -100) { console.log("C3"); return; } // 10. Determine answer // If Death Valley's max is within 0.5°C of global max (accounting for scale differences) if (dvMaxVal >= globalMaxVal - 0.5) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
